name: Move Amplifier - Re-ATK
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. It can also enhance an ST's Re-ATK.

61200.name: Movement Enhancement I - Re-ATK
61200.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
After triggering [Re-ATK], Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
